title: Sombr Surprises Fans With Fleetwood Mac Legend Lindsey Buckingham
summary:
Concert fans in Los Angeles got a big surprise on Saturday night. During his show at the Kia Forum, a large arena, the young singer Sombr brought out a special guest: Lindsey Buckingham, a guitarist and singer from the famous rock band Fleetwood Mac.

Before Buckingham walked out, Sombr told the crowd how much the musician means to him. "I'd like to welcome to the stage someone I look up to so much," Sombr said. "This man's music is one of my biggest influences. I grew up on this guy." He also called Buckingham "a great mentor, a great person." A mentor is someone who gives advice and guidance.

Buckingham then led Sombr and his band in playing "Go Your Own Way." The song is a classic from Rumours, one of Fleetwood Mac's best-known albums.

Buckingham was not the only surprise of the night. Earlier in the show, Jesse Rutherford, the singer of the band the Neighbourhood, joined Sombr onstage to perform the song "Sweater Weather."

The concert is part of Sombr's You Are the Reason Tour, which will keep him traveling for many months. The North American part of the tour ends in late November with two shows at Madison Square Garden in New York City. In December, Sombr will appear at four Jingle Ball holiday concerts. In January 2027 he heads to Mexico and South America, and later he will tour Australia and Europe.

For now, the tour is set to end on July 17, 2027, at the Lollapalooza music festival in Berlin, Germany. That is a long road trip for one singer and his band.
why_it_matters: The moment shows how musicians from different generations connect through songs that inspire them. It also gives fans a glimpse of how a young artist honors his heroes on a big stage.
